name: One-Line Parrot
effect: Answers are cut down to a single short sentence or a fragment that stops mid-thought ('The meaning of life is'). It often just echoes the prompt back ('What should I cook for dinner tonight?', 'I am, really?', 'I failed your driving test to
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
